digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API removal and external live integration tests
propositions: rebar.llm.review_ticket() public API was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external live test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes

tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and tests/external/test_llm_trace.py were missed during the removal epic and are excluded from the standard Verified gate, making the regression invisible until live workflow dispatch

review_plan() cannot replace review_ticket() calls directly because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings) instead of REVIEW_RESULT, breaking existing test assertions for runner/model/findings
both external test modules must retarget to rebar.llm.review_code() which returns REVIEW_RESULT with the required runner/model/findings fields matching existing assertions
retargeting to review_code with enabled code review gate (REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW=1) preserves intended test behavior including pydantic_ai model validation and trace-round-trip verification
